# Process: sending a reminder

A model of an irreversible send. The text must leave once, and the report must say only what is proven.

## States

| State | Meaning | Terminal | Recorded durably |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | The request is accepted, nothing is recorded |  |  |
| `intent-recorded` | The intent is recorded durably and will be visible after a restart |  | yes |
| `sending` | The request went to the provider, the outcome is unknown |  |  |
| `awaiting-proof` | The provider accepted the request, delivery is not proven |  |  |
| `confirmed` | The text is found in the recipient's feed | yes |  |
| `unconfirmed` | Accepted, but there is no proof; a person checks by hand | yes |  |
| `failed` | Nothing was sent | yes |  |
| `duplicate-blocked` | The intent is already recorded: the text may have left; a repeat is forbidden, a person checks by hand | yes |  |

## Transitions

| Transition | From | To | When | Irreversible |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reminder.provider-unknown` | `idle` | `failed` | The provider is not in the config |  |
| `reminder.duplicate-blocked` | `idle` | `duplicate-blocked` | This reminder already has a record |  |
| `reminder.intent-recorded` | `idle` | `intent-recorded` | The intent is recorded |  |
| `reminder.send-started` | `intent-recorded` | `sending` | The request is being sent | yes |
| `reminder.send-refused` | `sending` | `failed` | The provider refused |  |
| `reminder.send-accepted` | `sending` | `awaiting-proof` | The provider accepted the request |  |
| `reminder.delivery-confirmed` | `awaiting-proof` | `confirmed` | The text is found in the feed |  |
| `reminder.delivery-unproven` | `awaiting-proof` | `unconfirmed` | Time ran out, the text is not in the feed |  |
